task_context.problem_statement: John has a raw squat of 600 pounds without sleeves or wraps.  Sleeves add 30 pounds to his lift.  Wraps add 25% to his squat.  How much more pounds does he get out of wraps versus sleeves.
task_context.reference_solution:
Wraps add 600*.25=<<600*.25=150>>150 pounds to his lift
So they add 150-30=<<150-30=120>>120 pounds more than sleeves
#### 120
